mapper.select: SELECT movie_id, title, release_year, rating_count, ROUND(avg_score, 2) AS avg_score FROM movie_agg ORDER BY ${orderBy} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT rg.movie_id AS movie_id, g.genre_name AS genre_name FROM rel_movie_genre rg JOIN dim_genre g ON g.genre_id = rg.genre_id WHERE rg.movie_id IN #{id} ORDER BY g.sort_no

SELECT m.movie_id, m.title, m.release_year, COUNT(r.rating_id) AS rating_count, ROUND(AVG(r.score), 2) AS avg_score FROM dim_movie m LEFT JOIN fact_rating r ON r.movie_id = m.movie_id WHERE m.movie_id = #{id} GROUP BY m.movie_id, m.title, m.release_year
SELECT g.genre_name FROM rel_movie_genre rg JOIN dim_genre g ON g.genre_id = rg.genre_id WHERE rg.movie_id = #{id} ORDER BY g.sort_no
SELECT DISTINCT tag FROM fact_tag WHERE movie_id = #{id} ORDER BY tag LIMIT 20
SELECT rated_month AS period, COUNT(*) AS rating_count, ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS avg_score FROM fact_rating WHERE movie_id = #{id} GROUP BY rated_month ORDER BY period
